name: What are the primary benefits of building an ADU on my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the primary benefits of building an ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an ADU offers several benefits. It can provide a dedicated space for family members, such as aging parents or adult children, promoting multi-generational living while maintaining privacy. ADUs can also serve as a source of rental income, helping to offset mortgage costs or provide additional financial stability. Furthermore, an ADU can significantly increase your property's value and provide flexible space for a home office, guest suite, or studio, adapting to evolving lifestyle needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include housing family, generating rental income, increasing property value, and creating flexible space for various uses.
